title: Skill contract
summary: A skill packages a procedure; the host supplies execution and enforcement.

sections.label: Include
items: Trigger and the problem it addresses.
Supporting scripts, examples, and referenced resources.

sections.label: Scope
sections.text: Keep persistent repository instructions concise. Place specialized procedures in targeted skills. Exact repetitive logic belongs in scripts or tools.

sections.label: Limit
sections.text: A skill does not enforce permissions, persist a job, or prove that its instructions were followed successfully.

sections.label: Gap review: workflow use and checks
sections.text: Define the skill boundary during Architecture and impact, write the reusable procedure during Development and review its contract with representative cases. This mapping and checklist do not reverify every existing Agent Skills specification or host behavior claim. A package is not evidence that its procedure executed or that permissions are enforced.

sections.label: Gap review: acceptance outputs
items: The skill contract names a trigger, required inputs, procedure, outputs, checks and failure or escalation conditions.
Referenced scripts and resources resolve at the intended revision, with runtime permissions and tool dependencies named separately.
Representative trigger, missing input and failure cases produce reviewed expected outputs or remain explicitly untested.

catalog.applicability: Use when writing or reviewing a skill, so that it states its trigger, required inputs, procedure, expected output, acceptance checks, failure conditions and supporting resources. A skill does not enforce permissions, persist a job or prove that its instructions were followed.
catalog.limits: Reading a topic does not configure tools, execute a workflow or establish passing evidence.
